name: Journal
description: A private journal your character keeps. Write entries with checklists and simple formatting, and type @ to link an NPC, a place or your character. Nothing in it reaches the story on its own: Remind GM sends an entry with your next message as an out-of-character note, Show in scene sends it as shown or read aloud in the story, and Ask GM can read the entries you have not marked Private.
author: Narrative Engine
